definitions.window: inclusive start and end; sampled extrema
definitions.force: external plantar / ground-reaction normal force, not internal knee force
definitions.contact_time: sum of sample intervals above threshold; no crossing interpolation
definitions.impulse: trapezoidal integration over the full annotated window, N*s
definitions.loading_rate: average dF/dt from first above-threshold sample to peak, N/s
definitions.pressure_means: arithmetic means over valid above-threshold contact samples
definitions.asymmetry: abs(left-right) / ((left+right)/2) * 100; null if denominator is zero
definitions.missing_data: no interpolation; incomplete signals yield null metrics with reasons
